messages:
lin: Quick sync: we're rolling a minimal base-image rebuild and switching to an AWS KMS asymmetric signing key for the container signer. Goal: reduce CVE exposure and centralize signing. Need RBAC, audit routing, and a clear canary rollback trigger.

devon: thumbs up. runtime changes? cosign supports awskms:// right? we'll need the new key arn and the runtime sidecar to support fetching verification keys from S3.

rahul: correct. key arn: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345. We'll create an IAM role "ci-container-signer@redwood" with kms:Sign and kms:GetPublicKey. Principle of least privilege only.

lin: important: CI should assume-role into that role via STS. No long-lived creds on CI agents. Also limit AssumeRole to our CI OIDC provider and add a condition for sourceIp of the CI pool.

rahul: will prepare the role and a short Terraform snippet.```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "ci_signer" {
  name = "ci-container-signer"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.ci_assume.json
}
# policy allows kms:Sign only on the single key
```

sophie: Audit: we must emit structured audit events to splunk:index=infra_audit and to the internal SIEM (via kafka) with schema: {"event":"image.sign","key_arn":"...","requestor":"...","image":"...","digest":"...","result":"success|fail"}. Also ensure KMS CloudTrail entries are retained 1y and forwarded.

devon: for runtime verification plan: sidecar will try local S3 cache at s3://redwood-keys/container-signer/pubkeys.json then fallback to sigstore transparency log if missing. Verification job:```bash
cosign verify-blob --key awskms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:1234:key/abcd /tmp/image.sig /tmp/image.tar
```
If verification fails, canary pipeline marks build FAILED and triggers rollback hook to the deployment controller.

build-bot: NOTE: dry-run: canary-1 failed verification (image:sha256:1111) at 2025-07-02T14:02:12Z - public key not found.

lin: dry-run expected. Action items: 1) rahul: create IAM role + KMS key policy + rotation plan, 2) devon: sidecar S3 fetch + startup probe + cosign bump, 3) sophie: audit forwarder + schema tests + retention rules, 4) sec: vulnerability triage owner?

sophie: I'll triage the busybox CVE and ensure we have SBOM entries for the base layers. Plan is rebuild base -> run trivy/clair -> sign -> canary. If trivy finds high/critical, stop and escalate to sec-eng pager.

rahul: note on rotation: maintain previous public keys in pubkeys.json for 120 days so old images verify. We'll also add key_id and rotation_version metadata into image signature annotations.

devon: add a canary rollback window: if >5% of canaries across clusters fail verification in a 15m sliding window, auto-abort rollout and notify #release-war-room + create incident in pagerduty.

lin: good. Also a small incident playbook: steps to investigate verification failures: 1) check pubkeys.json S3 object and ETag, 2) check KMS GetPublicKey CloudTrail events, 3) check CI signing logs (ci-logs bucket), 4) manual verify with cosign and that specific key arn.

sophie: I'll write the compliance checklist: mapping audit events -> Jira ticket fields, retention proof, and evidence pack for SOC.

rahul: PR incoming for IAM/Terraform. I'll add conditional on aws:SourceIp and aws:PrincipalTag:ci=true.

devon: I'll open runtime PR with a small verify job excerpt in the pipeline:```yaml
- name: verify-canary
  image: gcr.io/cosign/cosign:1.15.0
  args: ["verify", "--key", "awskms://arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd", "${IMAGE}"]
```
If verify exits non-zero: curl -XPOST https://ops-api.internal/rollbacks -d "{\"image\":\"${IMAGE}\",\"reason\":\"signature-verify-fail\"}"

lin: timeline proposal: IAM by EOD, sidecar + audit forwarder by tomorrow AM, rebuild + sign midday, canary at 14:00, full rollout 18:00. If any verification or SBOM high vuln, abort.

build-bot: REMINDER: pin runbook to thread. oncall schedule will be notified 30m before canary.
